{{Quote|Droids!|Nub and trooper Droidbait|audio=Nub-Droids.flac|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Republic">''[[The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Nub''', an acronym that stood for "'''N'''on-'''U'''seful '''B'''ody," was of a [[Shiny/Legends|rookie]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Nub was stationed at a Republic [[Rishi Station/Legends|listening post]] on the [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] [[Rishi moon|moon]]. Along with other rookie [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], Nub maintained the [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] to warn the Galactic Republic of any impending [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] attacks near Rishi. When [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[O'Niner/Legends|O'Niner]], the station's commanding [[Officer/Legends|officer]], lost contact with deck [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[CT-327/Legends|CT-327]], he ordered Nub and trooper [[Droidbait/Legends|Droidbait]] to find CT-327. The clones, however, were unaware that the station itself was [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|under attack]] by Separatist [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] ambushed and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Nub and Droidbait by the station's entrance.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You two. Go find him.|O'Niner, ordering Nub and Droidbait to find trooper CT-327|audio=ONiner-You2.flac|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Republic" />}}
[[File:Nub.png|thumb|left|180px|Nub responds to orders to find CT-327]]
The [[Shiny/Legends|rookie]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] Nub, whose nickname was an acronym that stood for "Non-Useful Body,"<ref name="ep guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}}</ref> served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="rookies" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Nub, along with rookie [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] and [[Droidbait/Legends|Droidbait]],<ref name="ep guide" /> was assigned to [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]], a Republic [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] located on the [[Rishi moon|moon]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Under the command of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[O'Niner/Legends|O'Niner]], Nub and the other rookie troopers monitored nearby [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and were tasked with warning the Republic of any [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] attacks. Unbeknownst to the clone troopers, the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] planned to attack the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="rookies" />

Knowing that the clones at Rishi Station would detect the attack, Grievous deployed several [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] to [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|capture]] the Rishi listening post. Inside the station, O'Niner lost contact with deck [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[CT-327/Legends|CT-327]], who was patrolling outside the listening post. Unaware that the commando [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had [[Death/Legends|killed]] CT-327, O'Niner ordered Nub and Droidbait to find the missing trooper. However, after the two clones opened the listening post's [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] entrance, the commando droids revealed themselves and attacked Nub and Droidbait, killing them. The commando droids gained control of the facility, although the surviving rookie clone troopers—Fives, [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], and [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]]—retook the base with the help of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]].<ref name="rookies" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Nub stood<ref name="rookies" /> at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height.<ref name="databank" /> Nub wore sleek white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone armor]]. After O'Niner ordered Nub and Droidbait to find CT-327, Nub obeyed the order, although the decision cost him his life.<ref name="rookies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nub first appeared as an unnamed clone in "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]," the fifth episode in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], which aired on [[October 24]], [[2008]]. The episode's accompanying episode guide gave Nub his acronymic name.<ref name="ep guide" /> Nub later received a short entry in 2008's ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and appeared in the "Rookies" tie-in novel, ''[[The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Republic]]'', which was released on [[October 7]], [[2010]]. In ''Defenders of the Republic'', Nub is referred to as "NUB."
